title: Creating and Selling High-Ticket Info Products Using AI
summary: Steven Thiel explains how to turn life experience and professional knowledge into a high-ticket info product ($3,000 to $5,000) using an AI prompt. He outlines a three-step model covering product structuring via AI, organic content generation on Instagram, and booking sales calls.
key_points: Target demographic: The creator states this model works best for people aged 28 to 60 because they have career experience, business experience, or personal transformations that left behind monetizable skills and knowledge.

Step 1 (AI Product Structuring): Feed an interview prompt into Claude or ChatGPT that acts as an 'offer architect' to extract your knowledge and design a structured $3,000–$5,000 high-ticket digital offer.

Step 2 (Content Creation): Record talking-head Instagram Reels speaking directly into the camera about topics directly related to your offer. The creator claims this works even with fewer than 1,000 followers.
Step 3 (Sales & Fulfillment): Direct viewers into your Instagram DMs, book them onto sales calls, and close them on your offer.
Scaling: Repeat the cycle until revenue allows hiring appointment setters to handle DMs and sales reps/closers to conduct calls, freeing up the creator's time.

Post caption:
@elonmusk I got you. Don’t worry

Transcript:
So I got an interesting message the other day. So I just played it cool, I didn't know what he wanted. Then it got really interesting. I don't know what he's talking about here. Asked for the new Roadster. But what he said next I did not expect, so here it is. He's actually asking me for help with his brother. Apparently, he's looking for his brother's next thing, and he must have seen my videos. And this type of person is so perfect for the thing that I sent them next. Now, this script right here is what I sent them. And if you paste that into Claude or ChatGPT, it will interview you and extract the knowledge that you have and help you figure out what product you could sell for a high-ticket price point online. If you want to try it, too, you can DM me the word SCRIPT. Now, while these messages are fake, the application of what I'm showing is very real. I've shown lots of people how to do this. They created their high-ticket product, and then they made videos like this to help them sell it. And a lot of them had less than 1,000 followers. This works really well for people who are aged around 28 to 60 because you've, at this point, had life experience, you've maybe had a career where you learned valuable things, or a business at this point, or some transformation you've been through. All these things leave behind skills and knowledge that you can then take and turn into a product that you can sell online for a high-ticket price point, otherwise known as selling your knowledge or an info product. The steps are simple: you paste that prompt I mentioned earlier into Claude or ChatGPT, it will interview you, it will help you build the structure for the product. Then you post Instagram videos like this talking directly to the camera about topics related to your product. You get people in your DMs, you book them on sales calls, you sell them your product, then you cycle that and repeat until you can then hire people to handle your DMs, hire people to close the deals for you, and then you scale this business. Now, you can figure this out with Google, AI, or it just might take months, maybe even years. The only reason you'd pay somebody like me is if you want somebody who has everything laid out for you to fast-track your success. So it really just comes down to do you value your time or your money more? One of those we have a finite resource of. So if you value your time more and you want to learn how to do this quickly from somebody who has done it before and shown other people how to do it, then DM me the word CALL and we can set up a time to discuss if what I do is a fit for you.
